title: CrossCheck II: A Compiler Plugin for Certified Cost Bounds of Real-Time C and C++ Code, and its Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.31449v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We describe a plugin for the Clang compiler that bounds the cost of C and C++ functions intended for real-time use, and rejects at compile time the functions that allocate, throw, call through pointers, or contain a loop or a recursion for which no bound is found. Loops are bounded by affine ranking potentials synthesized with an SMT solver through Farkas' Lemma, or by logarithmic ones, recursion by depth and size potentials, and callees are analyzed in the calling context in which they are used. For functions in a linear fragment, the plugin emits a cost certificate that a checker, compiled from a Lean~4 definition proved sound in a companion paper, validates with integer arithmetic only; the bound then depends neither on the analyzer nor on the solver. On the 29 kernels of the TACLeBench collection, without annotations, the plugin bounds 142 of 220 loops in the calling contexts of the programs, 131 of them exactly as the benchmarks'

translated_title: CrossCheck II：用于实时C与C++代码认证成本界限的编译器插件及其评估
translated_abstract: 我们描述了一个Clang编译器插件，该插件为面向实时用途的C和C++函数界定成本界限，并在编译期拒绝那些进行内存分配、抛出异常、通过指针调用，或包含无法找到界限的循环或递归的函数。循环的界限通过利用Farkas引理由SMT求解器合成的仿射排名势函数来确定，或采用对数势函数；递归则通过深度和规模势函数来确定；被调用函数在其被使用的调用上下文中进行分析。对于线性片段中的函数，该插件会生成一份成本证书，由一个检查器（由Lean 4定义编译而成，其正确性已在配套论文中得到证明）仅使用整数算术进行验证；这样，界限的正确性既不依赖于分析器，也不依赖于求解器。在TACLeBench基准集合的29个内核上，在无需注解的情况下，该插件在程序的调用上下文中为220个循环中的142个确定了界限，其中131个与基准测试的（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了Clang编译器插件CrossCheck II，能够自动为实时C/C++代码计算成本界限并生成经Lean 4验证的成本证书，使界限的正确性不依赖于分析器和求解器，且在TACLeBench基准上无需注解即可界定220个循环中的142个。
en_tdlr: CrossCheck II is a Clang compiler plugin that automatically computes certified cost bounds for real-time C/C++ code, emitting cost certificates validated by a checker proved sound in Lean 4—making bounds independent of the analyzer and solver—and bounds 142 of 220 loops in TACLeBench benchmarks without annotations.
